about: Every item a player can carry (scripts/items/item_db.gd reads it on every peer: the inventories, the screens, the host's checks). `category`: weapon, ammo (later: food, medical, tool). `stack`: how many fit in one inventory slot. `hotbar`: put on the hotbar first when picked up (things used from the hand). `confiscable`: taken by the police on an arrest (to come). `icon`: the glyph the screens draw (scripts/items/item_icons.gd), in `color`. A weapon: `ammo` (the item it fires), `capacity` (rounds loaded at once), `reload` (s to load one), `cooldown` (s between two shots), `range` (m), `effect` (what a hit does: tased, netted; scripts/items/people.gd), `stun` (s), `shot` (hitscan: there at once; net: a projectile flying at `speed` m/s, falling at `gravity` m/s²), `spread` (rad), `behaviour` (its script in scripts/items/weapons/).

taser.name: Taser
taser.about: Two darts on wires: whoever they hit drops, shaking, for a few seconds.

net_gun.name: Net gun
net_gun.about: A pump-action launcher firing a weighted net: whoever it catches is tangled up on the ground.

taser_cartridge.name: Taser cartridge
taser_cartridge.about: One shot of the taser: its two darts and their wires.

net_shell.name: Net shell
net_shell.about: One folded net for the net gun.
